stage_crosswalk.mining: Register an owner-authorized mining observation/bounded header job. No outside miner started.
Axis Alpha computes actual double-SHA-256 historical block-header hashes using a small nonce range. Not a biological flash or conscious state.
Axis Beta recomputes and verifies candidate header hashes against Bitcoin's historical genesis target. No permanent lockout or wallet key control.
Prepare bounded, explicit 21-ring workload mapping; do not start 732 million processes, self-modify or connect to pools.

mining_source_note: The original 16:1 output/energy relationship and five-million-proxy mask are design records, not observed profitability or actual deployed proxies.
author_motto: Yes is Yes — No is No
next_real_deployment_gate: owner-controlled hardware, measured electrical energy, separately verified payout address, correct coin algorithm, consent-scoped API, wallet confirmation, chain-specific consensus rules
